## The Numbers Tell the Story

Aug 30 delivered exactly what we look for: high-volume accuracy. 11 wins against 3 losses gives us a 78.6% hit rate across 14 games. When you're processing double-digit matchups in a single day, maintaining sub-80% accuracy is the benchmark. We hit it.

## Confidence Tier Breakdown

Let's segment by confidence levels. Our 60%+ picks went 6-1 (85.7%). That's where the model shines—high conviction, high accuracy. The 50-59% range delivered 5-2 (71.4%). Lower confidence picks are inherently coin-flip adjacent, but we still cleared 70%.

content.value:
## What the Misses Reveal

Only one high-confidence miss: Brewers at 61%. Rangers pulled the upset. Here's what matters: one outlier in 14 games is statistical noise, not systematic error. The model's edge compounds over volume. One bad break doesn't invalidate 11 correct calls.

## Key Takeaways by the Numbers

- **60%+ picks:** 6-1 (85.7% accuracy)
- **50-59% picks:** 5-2 (71.4% accuracy)
- **Average winning probability:** 57.1%
- **Highest confidence wins:** Dodgers & Braves (both 63%)
- **Closest call win:** Yankees at 50% exact

The Yankees pick at 50% flat is essentially admitting the matchup was a toss-up. We got it right anyway. That's variance working in our favor.
